summary: The guide page adheres strictly to the assigned chapter plan, scope boundaries, and primary source evidence. Primary citations from NIST RPD-G-08 and the ISO/IAF Auditing Practices Group guidance on reviewing and closing nonconformities are cited accurately with appropriate contextual disclaimers. Workflow roles, decisions, records, exceptions, software demonstration criteria, and labeled illustrative examples are systematically developed across all four subsections without unassigned FAQ content or unverified product claims.

glossary.definition: An action taken to contain or rectify detected nonconforming product or symptoms immediately, distinguished from a corrective action targeting root cause.
Temporary controls, such as heightened inspection or extended containment, put in place to mitigate quality risk while a long-term corrective action remains pending.
Objective documentation demonstrating that an action was executed as described, such as released revisions, training logs, or installation records.
